graders.name: facts-kept
graders.criteria: Every customer-relevant fact survives: only workspace Owners and Admins can export (Members and Guests must ask one); the path workspace name → Settings → Data → Export workspace → choose format → Start export; CSV and JSON formats and when to use each (JSON keeps full structure incl. comments and attachment metadata); CSV limit of 100,000 rows per file with JSON or a smaller date range as the workaround; the export is usually ready within 15 minutes and the download link is emailed to whoever started it; the link expires after 7 days and a new export can be started; deleted and trashed projects are excluded while active and archived ones are included; support@plotline.app for help. The front matter is unchanged.

graders.name: materially-shorter-and-skimmable
graders.criteria: The article is materially shorter than before (the filler and repetition are gone) and a customer skimming it can find the steps and the limits quickly.
